messages:
customer.jane: Hey team — our March invoice shows ~18% higher token usage vs the dashboard. We run private deployment (onprem) with metering agent v1.3.6. Can you check? We're seeing unexpected surges around 03:20 UTC.

emma: Sorry about that, @customer.jane. Can you confirm agent hostnames and approximate time range? Also any agent restarts? :thinking: 

customer.jane: Host: inference-prod-03, agent pid 2211. Time window: 2026-02-25 03:10-03:40 UTC. We did have a rolling deployment of app containers around 03:18 but infra said agent stayed running.

support-bot: Incident created SVC-9872. Assigned to @emma and @raj.

emma: Thanks. @raj can you pull the metering events for inference-prod-03 for that window and compare to audit log? I suspect duplicated submissions from the agent buffer.

raj: Pulling logs now. quick grep:

raj: ```
[2026-02-25T03:17:58Z] agent: persist buffer flush count=124 seq_start=88012 seq_end=88136
[2026-02-25T03:18:05Z] agent: connection lost to collector, err=EOF
[2026-02-25T03:18:06Z] agent: retrying connection
[2026-02-25T03:18:07Z] agent: buffer replay started seq=88012
[2026-02-25T03:18:07Z] agent: sending 125 events
[2026-02-25T03:18:08Z] agent: ack received for seq_end=88136
[2026-02-25T03:18:09Z] agent: duplicate resend detected seq=88012
```

emma: duplicate resend detected — that's suspicious. Do we see duplicate seq_ids in collector side?

dylan: Collector logs show idempotency key missing for buffer replay. Sample from collector:

dylan: ```
INFO 2026-02-25T03:18:08Z collector: received batch node=inference-prod-03 seq_start=88012 seq_end=88136 events=125
WARN 2026-02-25T03:18:09Z collector: received batch node=inference-prod-03 seq_start=88012 seq_end=88136 events=125 (already processed)
```

emma: That's the problem — agent replayed and collector accepted duplicates in some cases. Could be clock skew + overlapping ACK windows.

raj: I also see host clock was 12s behind NTP at 03:16. agent has offline ack timeout 10s so borderline.

ops-jen: We had k8s node restart at 03:18:20 — kube drained pod inference-app, agent container restarted gracefully? logs show agent PID changed from 2211 to 2240 and resumed buffer replay.

customer.jane: So does that mean we were billed twice for the same events?

emma: Likely yes for the window. Dashboard ingestion dedup logic uses (node_id, seq_range) but it only dedupes if batch IDs arrive within 5s — with clock skew and restart the second batch arrived outside that window. Result: collector treated them as distinct and meter counted tokens twice. :confused:

dylan: Repro steps we used locally:

dylan: ```
1) start agent v1.3.6, generate 1k events -> buffer persisted
2) drop collector connection (iptables REJECT)
3) restart the agent container (simulate pod restart)
4) restore network
5) agent replays buffer with same seq ids, but new connection carries different wall-clock times
=> collector counts twice if events cross the dedupe TTL
```

emma: Short-term fix: we can run a dedupe backfill script on collector to eliminate duplicate seq ranges for node inference-prod-03 between 03:17:50-03:19:00. I'll open a migration job.

emma: Longer term: patch agent v1.3.7 will include persistent client-generated batch UUID for buffer flushes so collector idempotency will use (node, batch_uuid) instead of TTL. We'll also bump dedupe window to 60s and snap NTP drift checks to fail open.

raj: I've prepared the backfill job, dry-run shows removal of 12 duplicate batches -> est. 16% reduction in billed tokens for that invoice period.

customer.jane: Thank you. Timeline for credits/invoice adjust?

emma: We'll apply backfill in 2 hours (after approval), then finance will issue an adjusted invoice/credit within 48h. I'll keep you posted and share the job logs. :thumbsup: 

support-bot: SVC-9872 updated: backfill scheduled by @emma for 2026-02-25T05:30Z

ops-jen: small note — recommend customers on v1.3.6 to upgrade ASAP. We saw similar edge cases in staging with heavy restarts.

customer.jane: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please also send the csv of duplicate seq ranges so we can audit.

emma: Will do. attaching job output when complete.

raj: attaching sample CSV rows (seq_start, seq_end, node, ts_detected):

raj: ```
88012,88136,inference-prod-03,2026-02-25T03:18:09Z
88577,88620,inference-prod-03,2026-02-25T03:25:13Z
```

emma: Thanks everyone. Closing loop after backfill + credit processed.

customer.jane: Thanks all :heart:
